tasks.name: Mobile Menu Logic
tasks.description: Implement a full-screen responsive mobile navigation menu overlay triggered by MobileMenuIcon, adhering to zero-visual-spec strict implementation rules.
acceptance: Clicking MobileMenuIcon opens a full-screen navigation overlay displaying all layout navLinks.
The overlay must feature an explicit, accessible close button (X) to dismiss the view.
Body scroll lock must be active when the menu is open by dynamically applying an 'overflow-hidden' utility to the document root/body.
Clicking any navigation link must successfully route the user and automatically close the mobile menu view.
Mobile menu state, events, and DOM hooks must fully survive Astro's ClientRouter transitions without hanging listeners or memory leaks (bind via 'astro:page-load').
Complex animation triggers or open/close state logic calculations must be extracted to a helper function within a utils file.

acceptance: Route or state based language toggle

tasks.name: Global Language Switch
tasks.description: Implement global language switching for the entire site using the existing language toggle. All visible content must support both Spanish and English, including section names/titles that currently only display the section name.
acceptance: All visible site content must support Spanish and English.
Changing the language must update the UI without requiring a page refresh.
Navigation labels and section titles must be translated.
Sections that currently only contain the section name/title must also support translation.
Language state must persist correctly during Astro ClientRouter navigation.
Responsive layouts must remain visually correct in both languages.

tasks.name: Section Anchor Routing
tasks.description: Implement section-based routing using URL hash anchors for all main site sections.
acceptance: Each main section must have a unique anchor id.
Navigation links must redirect using hash routes (example: /#about, /#portfolio, /#blog, /#contact).
The Home section must route only to '/'.
Navigation must perform smooth scrolling to the target section.
Active navigation behavior must continue working correctly with hash routes.
Section routing must work correctly on both desktop and mobile navigation.
Hash navigation must survive Astro ClientRouter transitions.
Directly opening a section URL with a hash must scroll correctly to the target section.

tasks.name: Section: Home Intro & Interactive Hobbies
tasks.description: Implement the complete Home section for desktop and mobile based on the provided visual references (02-about.png). The Astro container component already exists and must not be recreated. Focus only on the internal section structure, responsive layout, typography hierarchy, interactive hobby behavior, image transitions, localization support, and strict visual parity with the design references.
acceptance: Implement the Home section — this is NOT a Hero component. The Astro wrapper/container already exists and must be reused.
Desktop layout must match the reference exactly: horizontal composition with the avatar image positioned on the right side and the text content block aligned on the left side.
Desktop navbar spacing and top alignment must visually match the reference with sufficient horizontal whitespace and centered vertical alignment.
Mobile layout must stack content vertically in this order: top controls/header, avatar image centered, intro text block below image.
On mobile, all typography and spacing must match the reference proportions with large multi-line heading text and increased paragraph readability.
The following words must use <strong>: 'frontend', 'backend', 'CI/CD', 'inteligencia artificial generativa', 'machine learning'  and 'LLMs'
All Home section textual content must come from data/about.
The data/about source must support both Spanish and English localized versions.
Language switching must dynamically swap all Home section content using the existing localization approach of the project.
The default avatar image must be 'working.png'.
Desktop avatar sizing must visually match the reference with the character occupying a significant vertical area without overpowering the typography.
Mobile avatar sizing must be reduced proportionally and centered with balanced spacing above the heading.
Desktop text block must maintain readable line length and left alignment exactly as shown in the reference.
Mobile typography must wrap naturally into multiple lines exactly like the screenshot reference.
The section background must preserve the dark navy aesthetic from the reference.
Spacing between paragraphs must match the visual rhythm shown in both references.
The implementation must preserve responsiveness across intermediate tablet widths without broken alignment.
All interactive logic must be extracted into reusable helper/util functions where appropriate.
No inline hardcoded content is allowed inside the component.
Implementation must strictly match the provided visual references for both desktop and mobile.
The icon diamond is in components/icons
The color for strong text must be --color-word
